description: Sample of BRÉHAT traffic data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Farid Arthaud. A sample of one week of train traffic on the French National Rail Network (NRN), from the BRÉHAT database of SNCF Réseau. The data ranges from 2018-01-08 to 2018-01-14, and all files are compressed using zstandard. The brehat files contains raw observations in json format, as a list of events. Coverage: national (FR); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
